purpose: Determine whether fixed useful document-QA requests encounter actual native KV allocation rejection/preemption with concrete request consequences. No new admission controller.
arrival: 128 requests all at zero; finite burst with full drain, not steady state
configuration_scope: Only max_num_seqs128 and max_num_batched_tokens2048 match the pinned direct LLMEngine ENGINE_CONTEXT default values. Model,8GiB,context8192 and remaining restricted settings are explicit. This is not an unmodified public LLM default.

whole_batch_quality_gate.request_success: All asked subparts of all three questions correct and source-supported, with no material unsupported claims in the response. Same frozen QA16 rubric. Missing/partial quotations and nonverbatim faithful phrasing are reported separately; no full citation-compliance claim. Incorrect numbers, dates, relations and fabricated evidence are material errors.
whole_batch_quality_gate.judging: Blinded model/performance/configuration labels. Whole source and pre-generation keys only. Retain all128 including failures. Exact same source/questions/response bytes may reuse prior QA16 judgment with explicit hash provenance; changed responses need fresh judgment. Uncertainty and conservative sensitivity remain visible. Same-family LLM judgments are not human gold.

All request host return times, completion,EOS,token counts and quality
positive: Only if whole-batch quality passes and actual KV rejection/preemption affects requests, localize the events and compare strongest simple and nearest prior-art mechanisms before implementing any new controller. Pressure alone is not benefit or novelty.
negative: A valid run with no KV rejection/preemption and substantial headroom stops capacity search in this exact regime. Do not shrink KV, change cap, select articles or increase concurrency to rescue it. If pressure exists but quality fails, stop this model-task formulation without treating degraded output as useful service.
invalid: Preserve failure and diagnose only the actual runtime/instrumentation error; no performance or no-go inference from incomplete execution. No automatic retry.
limits: Instrumented one-burst run gives no policy performance comparison,causal latency attribution,steady-state claim or p99 guarantee.
